column2: The Romanians use mainly outdated German equipment. Therefore, you have to buy/upgrade to German equipment as frequently as possible. You can do this in three different occasions. If you play well enough you can buy/upgrade to Soviet equipment in the last scenario. The strategy should be, buy the best Romanian equipment, increase its experience, of course avoid being destroyed and whenever possible upgrade it to German. Buy/upgr a de to equipment that can fight effectively the whole war, such as, 17K18 guns, Tiger tanks, FW190 A or D. The priority should be on guns first, tanks second, but try to buy at least one good fighter plane. Follow during the first part of the campaign a m ixed strategy. Build a balanced army, but at the same time follow a Recon/AD approach. The Romanians Recon units are during the first scenarios second to none, they can even fight against certain tanks. Buy 3 or 4 and use them following Kobi's strategi es. They are also cheap. I grew up two leaders, Kobi would have been proud of them.
column3: 罗马尼亚军主要使用过时的德国装备。因此，你必须尽可能频繁地购买/升级为德国装备。你有三次不同的机会可以这样做。如果你打得足够好，在最后一个场景中可以购买/升级为苏联装备。策略应当是：购买最好的罗马尼亚装备，提升其经验，当然要避免被消灭，并尽可能把它升级为德国装备。购买/升级为能有效打完整场战争的装备，例如 17K18 火炮、Tiger 坦克、FW190 A 或 D。优先顺序应是火炮第一、坦克第二，但尽量至少购买一架好的战斗机。在战役的前半段采用混合策略。组建一支均衡的军队，但同时走侦察/防空的路子。罗马尼亚的侦察单位在最初的几个场景中首屈一指，甚至能与某些坦克交战。购买 3 到 4 个，并按照 Kobi 的策略使用它们。它们还很便宜。我培养出两名指挥官，Kobi 会为他们感到骄傲。

column2: Scenarios:
column3: 场景：

column2: Dniestr (#1)
column3: 德涅斯特河 (#1)

column2: This is a tough scenario. You have to move through rough terrain and face several strong tanks on the way. Those tanks are even stronger tha n the German ones provided with the auxiliary German Corps. Develop a technique to destroy superior tanks. Play very conservative during the first 3 or 4 turns. Circle your units with infantry and tanks, put the artillery in support behind. Attack the tanks with you TB and artillery to finish them with a core tank or recon unit. The Northern group should move to the central Russian victory hex first and then move East. The German group has to be very careful because of several tanks in its way. I ac hieved a victory in my last turn.
column3: 这是一个艰难的场景。你必须穿过崎岖地形，途中还要面对若干强力坦克。那些坦克甚至比配属辅助德国军的德国坦克还强。摸索出一套摧毁优势坦克的方法。前 3 或 4 个回合要非常保守。用步兵和坦克把你的单位环绕起来，把炮兵放在后方支援。用你的战术轰炸机(TB)和炮兵攻击坦克，再用核心坦克或侦察单位将其消灭。北方集群应先向中央的俄国胜利格推进，然后再向东。德国集群必须非常小心，因为路上有几辆坦克。我在最后一个回合取得了胜利。

column2: Odessa (#2)
column3: 敖德萨 (#2)

column2: I bought a 100 mm gun, two recons and 2 tanks. This is a very tough scenario. I had to change twice the Soviet tanks, downgrading them. I have also to provide the Soviets with several range 3 instead of range 4 guns, otherwise it was impossible to win. You have to spread out all over the map. Extreme prudence is required during the first three turns. The Soviets also have good defenses inside the city itself. Play defensively; slowly pinpoint the enemy guns and then attack. I moved straight a big Northern group into the first Soviet victory hex. I ran into trouble by 3 Soviet tanks counterattacking. It took me 3 turns to destroy them. Rain that precluded the use of TB was a big problem. I surrendere d the northern airfield for the time being. I had trouble also with two Soviet recons attacking my guns. The fight for the city was also big trouble, a lot of well-dug artillery. My recons played a tremendous part, moving in and out attacking the guns. One of them became a leader and increased its experience more than 300 points!!
column3: 我购买了一门 100 mm 火炮、两个侦察单位和 2 辆坦克。这是一个非常艰难的场景。我不得不两次改动苏联坦克，把它们降级。我还不得不把苏联的若干射程 4 火炮换成射程 3，否则根本不可能取胜。你必须把部队散布到整张地图上。前三个回合需要极度谨慎。苏联军在城市内部也有良好的防御。采取防御打法；慢慢找出敌方火炮的位置，然后发起攻击。我直接指挥一支庞大的北方集群进入第一个苏联胜利格。我因 3 辆苏联坦克的反击而陷入麻烦。我花了 3 个回合才消灭它们。降雨使我无法使用战术轰炸机，这是个大问题。我暂时放弃了北方机场。我还因两个苏联侦察单位攻击我的火炮而遇到麻烦。争夺城市的战斗也很麻烦，那里有大量工事良好的炮兵。我的侦察单位发挥了巨大作用，进进出出地攻击火炮。其中一个成为了指挥官，经验值提升了 300 点以上！！

column2: After destroying the tanks in the North I had to rush to take the Eastern port. It was difficult due to long-range artillery on the islands nearby. I detached a small group to the North to prepare the final assault to the North victory hex. A couple of tanks created a lot of trouble also. I lost a couple of auxiliary units including a leader gun. After taking the Eastern port I moved all the way North. At the same time completed the city occupation. So, I had to rush to achieve a tactical victory.
column3: 在消灭北方的坦克后，我不得不急速夺取东部港口。由于附近岛屿上的远程炮兵，这很困难。我分出一支小部队前往北方，为对北方胜利格的最后突击做准备。几辆坦克也制造了不少麻烦。我损失了若干辅助单位，包括一门带指挥官的火炮。夺取东部港口后，我一路向北推进。同时完成了对城市的占领。所以，我不得不赶进度才取得战术胜利。

column2: Mius River (#3)
column3: 米乌斯河（#3）

column2: You can buy German equipment. I upgraded my guns to 17K18 and 15K18, my tank to PZIIIJ ;and upgrade a Romanian AD to a SKG6/2 mobile AD. I also boug ht 2 German PZIIIJ and a FW190 A fighter plane. The scenario is only moderately tough. A reflection on the power of the new equipment. I play-tested the scenario using the normal Sortavala map, by some reason the AI tried to send a big group through th e Southern lake. It put effectively out of play. The problem was that the lake hexes are considered to be river. This fact allows movement through the lakes. In this scenario the southern lake represents the Azov sea, not a lake, therefore, movement sh ould be precluded. After play-testing I have gotten from Steve Brown another map version that has the lake hexes turned to ocean. The scenario in all likelihood will be tougher. The file that will change the map is provided with the campaign.
column3: 你可以购买德国装备。我把火炮升级为 17K18 和 15K18，把坦克升级为 PZIIIJ；还把一个罗马尼亚防空单位升级为 SKG6/2 机动防空单位。我还购买了 2 辆德国 PZIIIJ 和一架 FW190 A 战斗机。这个场景只算中等艰难。这反映了新装备的威力。我用普通的 Sortavala 地图试玩了这个场景，不知为何 AI 试图派一大群部队穿过南部湖泊。这实际上让它退出了战斗。问题在于湖泊格被视为河流，这一设定允许部队穿过湖泊。在这个场景中，南部湖泊代表亚速海(Azov)，而不是湖泊，因此应当禁止通行。试玩之后，我从 Steve Brown 那里拿到了另一个地图版本，其中的湖泊格被改成了海洋。这个场景很可能会更艰难。改变地图的文件随战役一起提供。

column2: This is a defen se scenario, i.e., you will loose you northern and eastern victory hexes, and then will have to retake them. Try to establish a defense line by your central victory scenario and start your counterattack from there. Try to withdraw as many units as possi ble from the exposed victory hexes. You are going to loose them anyway.
column3: 这是一个防御场景，也就是说，你会失去北方和东方的胜利格，然后必须夺回它们。尽量在你的中央胜利格一带建立防线，并从那里发起反击。尽量从暴露的胜利格撤出尽可能多的单位。反正你都会失去它们。

column2: I got a victory. You have also to take a Soviet supply hex.
column3: 我取得了胜利。你还必须夺取一个苏联补给格。

column2: Spring Offensive (#4)
column3: 春季攻势 (#4)

column2: I bought 2 Romanians tanks PZIIIJ2, a 100 mm gun, an AD unit and 2 recons. The scenario is tough at the beginning. The right side group tried to take the 2 eastern victory hexes, while I concentrated the other group on a deep penetration to the West . You have to be careful during the first 2/3 turns. The Soviets have tough tanks there. I lost a core infantry unit there. I also got bogged-down on the eastern victory hex with the German group. I was attacked from all sides, by strong tanks. I lost a German tank there. After some tough moments I could take the two victory hexes and move forward to the last one. I got some problem with some good Soviet planes as well. After destroying the tanks the left group did not have much trouble. You only need to be a little cautious in attacking the city. I got a victory.
column3: 我购买了 2 辆罗马尼亚 PZIIIJ2 坦克、一门 100 mm 火炮、一个防空单位和 2 个侦察单位。这个场景开局很艰难。右翼集群试图夺取 2 个东方胜利格，而我让另一集群集中向西方深远突破。前 2/3 个回合你必须小心。苏联军在那里有强力坦克。我在那里损失了一个核心步兵单位。我还在东方胜利格与德国集群一起陷入了泥潭。我遭到四面八方强力坦克的攻击。我在那里损失了一辆德国坦克。经过一些艰难时刻，我得以夺取那两个胜利格，并向最后一个推进。我也因一些优秀的苏联飞机遇到了一些问题。消灭坦克后，左翼集群没有遇到太多麻烦。进攻城市时你只需稍微谨慎一些。我取得了胜利。

column2: Sevastopol (#5)
column3: 塞瓦斯托波尔（#5）

column2: I bought A 100 mm gun, a recon, an AD and a tank. The scenario is only moderately tough. You have a Soviet infantry screen supported by artillery guns. There are a couple of Soviet tank corps (6-7 tanks) behind the screen. I did not have much trouble breaking throug h the screen in the North and Southern parts of the front. I run into trouble in the center bridge and I lost a couple of auxiliary infantry units there. I got lucky and I did not loose any artillery or tank. The flank groups went strait for their tar gets and they got through. The recons were especially useful, entering hitting the guns and then retreating, hurt but alive to fight another day. One of them was a leader with devastating fire ability (650 experience points), a monster unit !!!
column3: 我购买了一门 100 mm 火炮、一个侦察单位、一个防空单位和一辆坦克。这个场景只算中等艰难。你面对的是由火炮支援的苏联步兵屏障。屏障后面有几个苏联坦克军（6-7 辆坦克）。我在战线北部和南部突破屏障时没有遇到太多麻烦。我在中央桥梁处陷入麻烦，并在那里损失了若干辅助步兵单位。我很幸运，没有损失任何火炮或坦克。侧翼集群直奔各自目标，并且成功通过。侦察单位尤其有用，它们进去打击火炮然后撤退，虽然受伤但还活着，改日再战。其中一个是拥有毁灭性火力（650 点经验）的指挥官——一个怪物单位！！！

column2: I slowly worked my way with the guns. I achieved a BV in the last turn.
column3: 我用火炮缓慢推进。我在最后一个回合取得了辉煌胜利。

column2: Grozny (#6)
column3: 格罗兹尼（#6）

column2: I got a Pz IVG 2 as a prototype. The first range 2 tank. You can not deploy all your units, therefore, I used the prestige mainly for upgrades. I used the new tank right away. The right group has the easiest tasks, while the left one can be in trouble immediately. You have to be conservative during the first 2-3 turns with the left and central groups. Charge in the right. Especially move slowly and together your units on th e left. The 2 mountain infantry divisions can move quickly, but the others only move one hex at a time. Do not separate them, there are Soviet tanks immediately out of sight. A good thing is that the infantry can stand up to the tanks on the rough terra in. Do not try your luck, if you got into gun range you will be in big trouble. The recons were once again key units , by spotting the Soviet guns and attacking them. I used my German guns to destroy the Soviet artillery. The lack of mobility due to terrain prevented me from getting a brilliant victory though.
column3: 我获得了一辆 Pz IVG 2 作为原型装备。第一辆射程 2 的坦克。你无法部署所有单位，因此我把威望主要用于升级。我立即使用了新坦克。右翼集群的任务最轻松，而左翼集群可能立刻陷入麻烦。前 2-3 个回合，左翼和中央集群必须保守。右翼则全力猛攻。尤其是左翼，要让你的单位缓慢而集中地移动。2 个山地步兵师可以快速移动，但其他单位一次只能移动一格。不要把它们分开，视野之外立刻就有苏联坦克。好处是步兵在崎岖地形上能顶住坦克。不要冒险，一旦进入火炮射程你就会有大麻烦。侦察单位再次成为关键，它们侦察出苏联火炮并加以攻击。我用我的德国火炮摧毁苏联炮兵。不过，地形造成的机动性不足使我未能取得辉煌胜利。

column2: Operation Uranus (#7)
column3: 天王星行动（#7）

column2: I bought a Pz IIIJ2 tank and a fighter Romanian plane. I mostly over-strengthened my units to increase their chances to survive. The scenario is tough, but not as tough as I exp ected. You have to plan right though. The isolated three northern hexes are lost. Therefore, I tried to retreat from some. I built a defensive parallel line at the level of the last victory hex. After 2/3 turns I started slowly a counterattack across the whole line. I have to slowly and methodically destroy the Soviet tanks by surrounding them with tanks and infantry, selecting one and firing all the guns until weakened. After that your tanks and recons can attack and destroy them. The range 2 tank was very helpful against the still range 1 Soviet tanks. I lost a core Romanian tank and an AD unit though. Once again the recons were extremely helpful. Particu larly in attacking the Soviet supply points. They are covered by heavy artillery and the Soviets got some reinforcements there. I got a victory.
column3: 我购买了一辆 Pz IIIJ2 坦克和一架罗马尼亚战斗机。我主要把单位超编，以提高它们的生存机会。这个场景很艰难，但不像我预期的那么艰难。不过你必须好好计划。北方那三个孤立的格将会失守。因此，我尝试从其中一些撤出。我在最后一个胜利格一线建立了一条平行防线。2/3 个回合后，我开始沿整条战线缓慢反击。我必须缓慢而有条理地消灭苏联坦克：用坦克和步兵包围它们，选定一辆，用所有火炮射击直到它被削弱。之后你的坦克和侦察单位就能攻击并消灭它们。射程 2 的坦克对付仍为射程 1 的苏联坦克非常有帮助。不过我损失了一辆罗马尼亚核心坦克和一个防空单位。侦察单位再次极为有用。尤其是在攻击苏联补给点时。它们由重炮掩护，而且苏联军在那里得到了一些补充兵员。我取得了胜利。

column2: Army was encircled anyway. This is a tough scenario. The Soviets have plenty of heavy armor. I had to provide the Axis with a couple of Tiger tanks above my original idea. I played it 3 times and I could not get through. You have to play very carefully the first 3/4 turns, especially in the nort hern and southern part of the front. The southern group has the most difficult task. It has to take two victory hexes. The northern group after defeating the Soviet tanks can go strait for the Soviet Northern victory hex. The Soviets have a defensive infantry screen supported by guns and lurking behind them 3 tank corps. Be careful, I lost a Romanian core tank and my army got pretty well battered, my average unit had a value of only 4. You learn here the meaning of fighting with outdated weaponry , you pay a price in blood for it. Most of them got a lot of experience though. I got a victory in the last turn.
column3: 军团还是被包围了。这是一个艰难的场景。苏联军有大量重型装甲。我在原本设想之外，不得不给轴心国配属了几辆 Tiger 坦克。我打了 3 遍都没能突破。前 3/4 个回合你必须非常小心，尤其是战线的北部和南部。南方集群的任务最困难，它必须夺取两个胜利格。北方集群在击败苏联坦克后，可以直奔苏联的北方胜利格。苏联军有一道由火炮支援的防御步兵屏障，屏障后面还潜伏着 3 个坦克军。小心，我损失了一辆罗马尼亚核心坦克，我的军队也被打得很惨，单位的平均价值只有 4。你在这里会体会到用落后武器装备作战的意味，为此要付出鲜血的代价。不过它们中的大多数都获得了大量经验。我在最后一个回合取得了胜利。

column2: Perekop (#9)
column3: 佩列科普 (#9)

column2: You can upgrade again to German equipment. I upgraded 3 of my tanks to Tiger, including the Pz IVG2 and one of my guns to a Humm el mobile gun. I also bought a mobile AD unit. I sold some of the less experience Romanian units to pay for this. This was not a tough scenario, but you have to take victory hexes all throughout the map. The isolated victory hexes are lost, therefore, you start by setting a defensive position at the level of the last victory hex. You will counterattack from there. Your tanks can fight with advantage with the range 1 Soviet tanks, but there are some KV85 range 2. I got a BV during play-testing. I ch a nged the scenario by adding more reinforcements to the Soviets. Tanks and planes, both. I expect the scenario to be even tougher now. You have to split your army into two groups, the bigger one on the West. After reaching the middle scenario you have to split again in two, with the smaller group going to the West. The eastern group will take the victory hexes there.
column3: 你可以再次升级为德国装备。我把 3 辆坦克升级为 Tiger，包括那辆 Pz IVG2，并把其中一门火炮升级为 Hummel 自行火炮。我还购买了一个机动防空单位。我卖掉了一些经验较少的罗马尼亚单位来支付这些费用。这不是一个艰难的场景，但你必须夺取遍布全图的胜利格。孤立的胜利格将会失守，因此你一开始要在最后一个胜利格一线设置防御阵地。你将从那里发起反击。你的坦克对射程 1 的苏联坦克有优势，但也有一些射程 2 的 KV85。我在试玩中取得了辉煌胜利。我修改了这个场景，给苏联军增加了更多补充兵员。坦克和飞机都有。我预计这个场景现在会更艰难。你必须把军队分成两个集群，较大的那个在西面。到达中部后，你必须再次一分为二，较小的集群前往西面。东方集群将夺取那里的胜利格。

column2: Sevastopol Evacuation (#10)
column3: 塞瓦斯托波尔撤退 (#10)

column2: You use only six units here; therefore, most of your prestige goes into over strengthening your units. I selected the three Tiger tanks, my 2 long-range guns and my experienced AD unit. The scenario is not tough, but you need to plan well. You send a strong group to take the two southern ports, i.e., 3 heavy tanks, a recon, two infantry units, two heavy guns and your Hummel there. In 3/4 turns you should have taken them. Meanwhile you have to move your fleet East, submarines first. You need to destroy the Soviet fleet. Once, you have taken the ports and destroyed or neutralized the Soviet fleet you sent by sea at least two heavy tanks and the Hummel gun toward the last port. You should from the beginning entrench you infantry inside the city. As soon as you have taken the ports send your long-range guns and spare tanks back inside the city. The Soviets w ill throw everything they have at you, but it is doubtful they can do anything. Be aware though that you need to hold all the victory hexes to win. If you lose a single one you are lost. The southern ports are especially vulnerable. Use the submarines to hold them. I manage to get a BV.
column3: 你在这里只能使用六个单位；因此，你的大部分威望都用于超编强化单位。我选择了三辆 Tiger 坦克、我的 2 门远程火炮和我经验丰富的防空单位。这个场景不艰难，但你需要好好规划。你派一支强力集群去夺取南方的两个港口，即 3 辆重型坦克、一个侦察单位、两个步兵单位、两门重型火炮以及你的 Hummel。3/4 个回合内你应该就能夺取它们。同时你必须把舰队调往东方，潜艇先行。你需要摧毁苏联舰队。一旦你夺取了港口并摧毁或压制了苏联舰队，你就通过海路把至少两辆重型坦克和 Hummel 火炮送往最后一个港口。你应当从一开始就让步兵在城市内构筑工事。一夺取港口，就把你的远程火炮和富余的坦克送回城内。苏联军会把所有力量都抛向你，但它们未必能有所作为。不过要注意，你必须守住所有胜利格才能获胜。只要失去一个，你就完了。南方港口尤其脆弱。用潜艇守住它们。我设法取得了辉煌胜利。

column2: Ploesti (#11)
column3: 普洛耶什蒂 (#11)

column2: This is a strange scenario. The idea is to depict a very heavy air battle. Unfortunately the game does not accommodate air fighting only, therefore, a commando action was added. You can deploy your a ir force and only 2 land units. I selected of course 2 Tiger tanks. I bought a Romanian Me-109G, to add to my FW190 A (1000, +5) and another Me-109G (320, +3). Your air force can not stand directly the Allied air onslaught. You have to hide your plane s especially the 2 Me-109G and the Henschel bomber. After 3-4 turns the AI custom of putting the planes directly on top of AD guns would have given you a break. Be careful, use the provided auxiliary German planes to lead the attack and only after your R o manian planes. The new plane I only used it when practically the sky was clear. It got 100 experience points though. You should not have much trouble with the land units. The combination, Tigers/Hummel/Recon should allow you to take the airfield victo ry hex without much effort once the air battle is won. The British Firefly is a fine tank, but it has low defense stats. I won a BV in the last turn.
column3: 这是一个奇怪的场景。其意图是表现一场非常激烈的空战。遗憾的是游戏无法只进行空战，因此加入了一次突击队行动。你可以部署你的空军，以及仅 2 个地面单位。我当然选择了 2 辆 Tiger 坦克。我购买了一架罗马尼亚 Me-109G，加入我的 FW190 A（1000，+5）和另一架 Me-109G（320，+3）。你的空军无法正面顶住盟军的空中猛攻。你必须藏好你的飞机，尤其是那 2 架 Me-109G 和 Henschel 轰炸机。3-4 个回合后，AI 习惯把飞机直接停在防空火炮上方，这会给你喘息之机。小心，用提供的辅助德国飞机带头进攻，之后才用你的罗马尼亚飞机。那架新飞机我只在天空基本清空时才使用。不过它获得了 100 点经验。地面单位方面你应当不会遇到太多麻烦。Tiger/Hummel/侦察单位的组合，应能让你在赢下空战后不太费力地夺取机场胜利格。英国 Firefly 是一辆好坦克，但防御数值低。我在最后一个回合赢得了辉煌胜利。

column2: Army Group Southern Ukraine (#12)
column3: 南乌克兰集团军群 (#12)

column2: You can upgrade/buy German equipment for the last time. I upgraded 2 AT units to JgPanther units, a 100 mm gun to a 17K18 and a PzIVG2 to a King Tiger. I sold a couple of under-experience Romanian units to pay for all this. All my heavy weaponry was modern German made at this point. The scenario is tough because you h ave to cross the river and take the Soviet supply victory hexes on the other side. You have to build a parallel defense line from the eastern city on the river to the west. Try to withdraw as many units as possible from the isolated victory hexes. Then , you counterattack from there. There is some heavy tank fights during the early turns. Be careful because the 13 Soviet infantry can be effective against your tanks on the rough terrain. The simplest plan is to take the Soviet eastern victory hex and t h en run a strong group to take the other victory hexes from behind. In this way you have a bridge to cross the river. The westernmost victory hexes can only be taken from across the river. You will have to concentrate your long-range artillery to suppor t the crossing. I got a BV. After that I added some Soviet reinforcements, to make it more spicy, tanks and planes, both. They will appear when you are in front of the supply victory hexes. You need to get at least a victory to continue.
column3: 你可以最后一次升级/购买德国装备。我把 2 个反坦克单位升级为 JgPanther 单位，把一门 100 mm 火炮升级为 17K18，把一辆 PzIVG2 升级为 King Tiger。我卖掉了一些经验不足的罗马尼亚单位来支付这一切。此时我所有的重型武器都是现代德国制造。这个场景很艰难，因为你必须渡河并夺取对岸的苏联补给胜利格。你必须从河上的东部城市向西建立一条平行防线。尽量从孤立的胜利格撤出尽可能多的单位。然后，你从那里发起反击。前期回合会有一些重型坦克交战。小心，因为苏联的 13 个步兵单位在崎岖地形上能有效对付你的坦克。最简单的方案是夺取苏联的东方胜利格，然后派一支强力集群从后方夺取其他胜利格。这样你就有一座桥可以渡河。最西面的胜利格只能从河对岸夺取。你必须集中你的远程炮兵来支援渡河。我取得了辉煌胜利。之后我增加了一些苏联补充兵员，让它更有味道，坦克和飞机都有。当你抵达补给胜利格前方时它们会出现。你至少需要取得一次胜利才能继续。

column2: Carpathian Mountains (#13)
column3: 喀尔巴阡山脉（#13）

column2: I bought a 100 mm gun and a Pz IVG 2 tank. This is a tough scenario. I played twice and I had to increase the number of turns and add an extra Hummel gun. I only got TV in the last turn before the changes. I retreated as many units as possible from the isolated victory hexes and I set-up a defensive line by the central victory hex, where the airfield is. You counter-attack from there.
column3: 我购买了一门 100 mm 火炮和一辆 Pz IVG 2 坦克。这是一个艰难的场景。我玩了两遍，不得不增加回合数并额外加入一门 Hummel 火炮。在修改之前，我只在最后一个回合取得战术胜利。我从孤立的胜利格撤出了尽可能多的单位，并在有机场的中央胜利格一带建立了防线。你从那里发起反击。

column2: The central group has to be the strongest, but you can not neglect the flanks, especially the Wester n group. The Soviets have heavy tanks plus reinforced infantry. The infantry is very aggressive, using the terrain to its advantage. I lost a couple of Tiger tanks during the previous play-testing. Once you have destroyed the tanks and heavy infantry you moved toward the supply hexes. Be careful heavy guns with a high level of entrenchment cover the supply hexes. They also took a toll on my army. I ended up with an average point value of 5 and I lost several auxiliary infantry units and an AT. My last play-test was a victory. It is enough to move to the last scenario.
column3: 中央集群必须最强，但你不能忽视两翼，尤其是西方集群。苏联军有重型坦克以及加强步兵。步兵非常凶悍，善于利用地形。在之前的试玩中我损失了几辆 Tiger 坦克。一旦你消灭了坦克和重型步兵，就向补给格推进。小心，工事等级很高的重型火炮掩护着补给格。它们也让我的军队付出了代价。我最终的单位平均数值为 5，还损失了若干辅助步兵单位和一个反坦克单位。我最后一次试玩取得了胜利。这足以进入最后一个场景。

column2: Hungary Plains (#14)
column3: 匈牙利平原 (#14)

column2: You can upgrade/buy Soviet equipment here. I only upgrade a 100 mm gun to a 15.2 and a PzIV (130, 1) to Il 2. New equipment will have the disadvantage of litt le experience, therefore, I used the rest of prestige to over-strength my units. This scenario has the strange sight of same units fighting on different sides. Even do not be surprised if you have taken a victory hex and still is German!!! Nothing is wr ong. Your Romanian units using German equipment are German to the AI, therefore, when they take an hex the flag turns into Germany's.
column3: 你可以在这里升级/购买苏联装备。我只把一门 100 mm 火炮升级为 15.2，把一辆 PzIV (130, 1) 升级为 Il 2。新装备的缺点是经验很少，因此我把剩余的威望用于超编强化我的单位。这个场景会出现同样的单位在不同阵营作战的怪现象。甚至当你夺取了一个胜利格而它仍属于德国时，也不要惊讶！！！这没有任何问题。你使用德国装备的罗马尼亚单位对 AI 来说就是德国单位，因此当它们夺取一格时，旗帜会变成德国的。

column2: You should divide you forces into a smaller group on the East and a big one on the West. The scenario is tough at the start . You need to be very careful during the first 3-4 turns. The AI has lots of German tanks and planes. Their mobility really surprised me. I lost several core units, especially infantry, a Tiger Tank and the 15.2 cm gun. The AI has also two very nice recons, PSW 234/4 with range 2. It squandered them, but not without destroying one gun. There is an infantry screen supported by AT and artillery guns. The AT guns especially are very strong. You should use your recons to spot the guns and then avoid them altogether. It can b e done. If you run into them you are in trouble because very strong and fast tanks are just lurking behind. I will love to play the AI side. Once you have achieved air superiority and destroyed some tanks you can move toward the victory hexes. The Eas t side group should move first and smash directly into Budapest. Use you long-range artillery to clear the German one. The western group should follow the central road and later on split again into left and right side groups. It is tough to take the western victory hexes by direct assault because heavy guns protect them. The victorious eastern group destroyed most guns from behind. I achieved a victory and a Field Marshal title. The storyline goes that your victories have maintained Romanian independence. We all know what happened.
column3: 你应当把部队分成东方的小集群和西方的大集群。这个场景开局很艰难。前 3-4 个回合你需要非常小心。AI 有大量德国坦克和飞机。它们的机动力着实让我吃惊。我损失了若干核心单位，尤其是步兵、一辆 Tiger 坦克和那门 15.2 cm 火炮。AI 还有两个非常好的侦察单位，即射程 2 的 PSW 234/4。它把它们浪费了，但还是摧毁了一门火炮。有一道由反坦克炮和火炮支援的步兵屏障。反坦克炮尤其强。你应当用侦察单位找出火炮，然后完全避开它们。这是可以做到的。如果你撞上它们就会陷入麻烦，因为非常强而快的坦克就潜伏在后面。我很想玩 AI 那一方。一旦你取得制空权并消灭了一些坦克，就可以向胜利格推进。东方集群应当先行，直接突入布达佩斯(Budapest)。用你的远程炮兵清除德国的炮兵。西方集群应沿中央道路前进，之后再分成左右两个集群。由于重型火炮保护，直接强攻夺取西方胜利格很艰难。取胜的东方集群从后方摧毁了大部分火炮。我取得了胜利，并获得了陆军元帅头衔。剧情是这样的：你的胜利维持了罗马尼亚的独立。我们都知道后来发生了什么。
